communication_goal: 明确请求排查材料的范围和需要保留的时间信息。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers stand at a small desk discussing a bug report. The tester on the right presents a clearly visible large paper printout showing a screenshot of a generic browser window with a blank rectangular dialog and small abstract control shapes. The developer on the left points to the printout while holding a pen. The whole screenshot printout rests centrally on the desk with a clear paper margin and no hands covering the browser frame. A desktop monitor in the background has only short abstract rows. No readable logs, dates, numbers, letters, code, or captions.

coverage_review.scope: W053 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W053.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：测试同事展示纸质界面截图，外缘、浏览器边框与提示框完整，开发者请求排查信息。截图局部可定位；日志、附件操作和时间戳由对白明确说明，无文字的背景屏幕不证明真实日志。
